Talk to Harold, upstairs in the bar in Burthorpe.
Take an Asgarnian ale from the bar.
Talk to Harold to give him a Blurberry Special.
Gamble with Harold (101 coins to immediately bankrupt him).
Go back to Burthorpe castle, and place the coloured stone balls in the correct spots on the mechanism.
Use the red stone on the mechanism.
Use the blue stone on the mechanism.
Use the yellow stone on the mechanism.
Use the pink stone on the mechanism.
Use the green stone on the mechanism.

Talk to Dunstan to exchange the climbing boots for spiked boots.

44,55: Enter the cave north west of Burthorpe.
Go northwest of Burthorpe, then south at the fork, and talk to Tenzing.
Bring the spiked boots, along with (unnoted) 10 bread and 10 trout to Tenzing.
44,56: Exit Tenzing's house into the backyard THROUGH THE NORTH DOOR and OVER THE STILE. Continue north past the Death Plateau warning, and around to the east until you stop and say you've gone far enough.
